documented_requirements: Use user-initiated top-level navigation; text-fragment navigation does not work inside an iframe.
Use noopener for a cross-origin new tab.
Keep the normal source URL, human-readable section locator, and find-in-page phrase available.
Treat highlighting as optional; unsupported browsers or changed page text may ignore the directive.
Do not include participant questions, private context or personal medical information in a citation fragment.
conclusion: Exact excerpt and article-anchor structure are verified against one downloaded source. Live scroll/highlight behavior is still unverified and must not be advertised as working.
